dialogues.speaker: Stroganov
dialogues.text: Nah. I'm talking about my younger sister. She goes to school in Snezhnograd and her teachers all say she's a real diligent learner! Heh. She sounds impressive, doesn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Stroganov
dialogues.text: But all work and no play makes Jill a really dull girl. So you've got to get out and get around a little, just like me.

dialogues.speaker: Stroganov
dialogues.text: I know she'll be worried about spending too much money. But all she has to do is to come out and have fun. I'll take care of the money part...
